next.in_short: Threat Group-3390 is tracked under many names, including APT27 and Emissary Panda. The catalogue lists the tools linked to it. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: Threat Group-3390 is the name MITRE uses for this actor.
The catalogue lists other names for it: Earth Smilodon, TG-3390, Emissary Panda, BRONZE UNION, APT27, Iron Tiger, LuckyMouse and Linen Typhoon.
The catalogue record lists many tools for the group, including PlugX, Cobalt Strike, Mimikatz, Impacket, gh0st RAT, China Chopper, HyperBro, SysUpdate and ZxShell.
It also lists built-in and common utilities such as Systeminfo, Tasklist, netstat, ipconfig and certutil.
No public report in this library describes its operations.
